sources.snippet: SpawnPoint-Coder-7B A 7B model fine-tuned for Spawn Point: it turns a game idea into a game brief, applies tweaks ("jump 20% higher, add a dash") and edits a single entity ("double its health and make it shoot fireballs") as strict JSON. 4-bit AWQ, runs on a single 12 GB GPU. sources.title: smoky1496/SpawnPoint-Coder-7B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SpawnPoint-Coder-7B GGUF GGUF builds of SpawnPoint-Coder-7B for Ollama, llama.cpp and LM Studio: run Spawn Point on a Mac, an AMD GPU or a plain CPU. A 7B model that generates Godot 4 games: you describe a game, it writes the design as strict JSON, and Spawn Point compiles it into a playable Godot 4 project.
